title: Technology Sector Update for 10/03/2018: WIFI,I,BILI,NOVT

Technology stocks were hanging on for moderate gains Wednesday afternoon, with the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 still adding over 0.3% in value while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was turning in a 0.1% increase.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) Boingo Wireless ( WIFI ) has been steadily extending its Wednesday gains, rising almost 4% shortly before the closing bell, after the internet connectivity company earlier priced a $175 million private placement of convertible senior notes due 2023. After first paying underwriter discounts and other offering expenses, the company estimates it will pocket around $169.6 million in net proceeds, growing to just over $195 million if underwriters exercise their overallotment option. The new money will be used to fund general corporate operations as well as potential acquisitions or strategic transactions and the costs of a capped call transaction to reduce potential dilution of existing shareholders if the convertible notes are changed into common stock.
In other sector news:
(+) Intelsat SA ( I ) climbed to a new, all-time high of $33.52 a share, rising over 8%, after the satellite communication company said its Intelsat Jackson Holdings unit has priced a $700 million private placement of 8.500% senior notes due 2024 at 100.75% of par plus accrued interest since Sept. 19. The wholly owned subsidiary expects to use net proceeds to redeem all of the remaining 7.50% senior notes due 2021 that were not redeemed using the proceeds of the parent company's private placement of 8.500% senior notes due 2024 on Sept. 19.
(+) Bilibili ( BILI ) still was up more than 8% higher Wednesday afternoon, giving back roughly half of its more than 16% rise soon after the opening bell that followed the online entertainment platform receiving a $317.6 million investment from Chinese internet behemoth Tencent. Under terms of the proposed transaction, Tencent will subscribe for nearly 25.1 million new class Z Bilibili shares at $12.67 each. After the deal closes, Tencent have a 12.3% ownership stake in Bilibili.
(-) Novanta ( NOVT ) still was edging lower during Wednesday trading, paring almost all of a nearly 2% decline earlier in the session that followed the photonics and precision motion components company saying it has acquired the final 24% of Laser Quantum it didn't already own for $45.7 million in cash and restricted stock. Laser Quantum produces solid state continuous-wave and femtosecond lasers for the medical market and Novanta said it expects the acquisition will increase its adjusted per-share earnings after closing. It will fund the deal using $30.7 million in available cash and borrowings from its credit facility in addition to issuing $15 million of restricted stock.
